changes.summary: Published OpenAPI 3.1, llms.txt, per-page Markdown and webhook JSON Schemas.
Replaced the ambiguous dynamic payload schema with oneOf/discriminator variants and explicit recipient/media constraints.
Added success response schemas and explicit error response contracts.
Documented typed query parameters and the existing lenient invalid-filter behavior; runtime behavior is unchanged.
Migrated the documentation site from GitBook to Docusaurus and reorganized navigation by business domain.
